title: Sales plan line
description: One planned quantity and value per plan version, plant, material or text line, customer, project and period (budget and business updates); source rows with the same key are summed.

_id.description: Deterministic key from the natural key; see title.

plantId.description: Platform plant (plants@1) resolved from the source plant code or name; null when unresolved (reported).

plantCode.description: Plant code or name exactly as the source states it.

materialNumber.description: Source material number without leading zeros; null for rows without a material.

articleId.description: articles@1 _id (<sapSystem>-<materialNumber>) when the plant's SAP system is known and the article exists; otherwise null.

period.description: YYYY-MM for monthly plan values, YYYY for yearly ones.

text.description: Source line text; identifies lines without a material number.

customer.description: End customer as named in the plan.

salesCategory.description: Source revenue category, e.g. third-party or intercompany production.

businessType.description: Source business type code, e.g. booked or potential.

quantity.description: Planned pieces; null when the source has only a value.

active.description: False when no longer present in the complete global source snapshot.
